title: Pasiphae
html_source:
PASIPHAE was an immortal daughter of the sun-god Helios. Like her siblings, Aeetes and Kirke (Circe), she was a skilled practitioner of witchcraft…As punishment for some offence against the gods–committed either by herself or her husband–she was cursed with lust for the king’s finest bull. The queen enlisted the help of the artisan Daidalos (Daedalus) who built her an animate, wooden cow wrapped in bovine-skin. Hidden inside the contraption she coupled with the bull and conceived a hybrid child–the bull-headed Minotauros (Minotaur).
